zig_optimize: ReleaseSafe (matrix, threads), ReleaseFast (releasefast file); native CPU target
leveldb_build: GCC 13.3.0, CMake Release (-O3), shared, Snappy/Zstd/tcmalloc disabled
database_filesystem: WSL2 /tmp on ext4 (virtual disk cached by the Windows host)
workload: full saves of four 16 KiB subchunks, biomes, block entities and entities; every fourth later save is full, the rest update one subchunk and entities
chunks: 64 (2 regions) and 4096 (4 regions), laid out in a 64-chunk-wide strip
leveldb_options: raw zlib compression, 64 KiB blocks, explicit LRU block cache of the listed size, verify_checksums on
zigritedb_options: default options, value cache of the listed size, automatic compaction on; record checksums are always verified
cold_reads: page cache dropped with posix_fadvise after the write phase and again after reopen; the host may still cache the virtual disk
